subject: Information Technology
text: In which year did the Government of India launch the National Action Plan on Climate Change (NAPCC)? (2026 Board)
explanation: The National Action Plan on Climate Change (NAPCC) was launched by the Government of India in 2008 as a framework for addressing climate change while promoting sustainable development.
whyWrong: 2005 is too early; NAPCC was not yet formulated at that time.
2010 is after the actual launch year of 2008.
2012 is the year of various other environmental meetings but not the NAPCC launch.

subject: Information Technology
text: Which of the following best describes active listening? (2026 Board)
options: A process of comprehending and offering support to the speaker
Interrupting the speaker to share your experiences
explanation: Active listening is an engaged, intentional process that involves fully understanding what the speaker is saying and showing support, not just hearing words or remaining silent.
whyWrong: Passive listening without responding is the opposite of active listening.
Hearing without comprehension is passive, not active.
Interrupting to share your own experience shifts focus away from the speaker and is counter to active listening.

subject: Information Technology
text: A workbook in a spreadsheet refers to: (2026 Board)
options: A spreadsheet with one or more worksheets
A rectangular box where a row and a column meet
The toolbar of the software application
explanation: In spreadsheet applications (e.g., LibreOffice Calc), a workbook is the entire file that contains one or more worksheets (tabs), allowing related data to be organised across multiple sheets.
whyWrong: A workbook can contain multiple documents/sheets, not just one.
A rectangular box where a row and column meet is a cell, not a workbook.
The toolbar is the interface element with buttons, unrelated to a workbook.

subject: Information Technology
text: Why are interpersonal skills important for an entrepreneur? (2026 Board)
options: They enable effective collaboration and teamwork.
They help in managing finances efficiently.
They ensure personal hobbies are pursued.
explanation: Interpersonal skills are social skills used in interactions with others. For an entrepreneur, they are crucial for building teams, motivating employees, negotiating with stakeholders, and fostering effective collaboration.
whyWrong: Managing finances is a financial/numerical skill, not interpersonal.
Technical knowledge is improved through education and practice, not interpersonal skills.
Pursuing personal hobbies is unrelated to entrepreneurial interpersonal skills.

subject: Information Technology
text: Which personality trait is characterized by anxiety, self-doubt, depression and excessive worrying? (2026 Board)
explanation: Neuroticism (one of the Big Five personality traits) is characterised by emotional instability — including anxiety, moodiness, self-doubt, depression and a tendency to experience negative emotions.
whyWrong: Extraversion is characterised by sociability, assertiveness and positive emotionality.
Agreeableness is characterised by cooperativeness, trust and empathy.
Openness is characterised by curiosity, imagination and willingness to try new experiences.

subject: Information Technology
text: The number of attributes in a relation is called the _____________ of a relation. (2026 Board)
explanation: In relational database terminology, the degree of a relation refers to the number of attributes (columns) in that relation. Cardinality refers to the number of tuples (rows).
whyWrong: Cardinality is the number of tuples (rows), not attributes.
A tuple is a single row/record in a relation, not a count of attributes.
Domain refers to the set of allowed values for an attribute, not the count of attributes.

subject: Information Technology
text: In a relational database, when the value of an attribute in a tuple is not known, not available or not applicable, which special value is used to represent it? (2026 Board)
explanation: NULL is the special marker in relational databases used when the value of an attribute is unknown, missing or not applicable. It is not the same as zero or an empty space.
whyWrong: ZERO (0) is a numeric value; it cannot represent an unknown or inapplicable attribute.
SPACE is a character value; it is not the standard marker for missing data.
DEFAULT is a constraint specifying a fallback value when none is provided, but it does not indicate 'unknown'.

subject: Information Technology
text: Which of the following is NOT an advantage of using a DBMS? (2026 Board)
explanation: A DBMS is designed to reduce data redundancy and duplication by centralising data storage. Increased data duplication is a disadvantage of file-based systems that DBMSs are meant to eliminate.
whyWrong: Reducing data redundancy IS a key advantage of DBMS.
Improved data consistency IS an advantage — a DBMS enforces integrity constraints.
Improved data availability IS an advantage through concurrent access and backups.

subject: Information Technology
text: Which of the following is an invalid variable name in Java? (2026 Board)
explanation: In Java, variable names cannot contain the hyphen (-) character because it is the subtraction operator. 'total-Marks' would be interpreted as 'total minus Marks', not a variable name. Underscores and alphanumeric characters are valid.
whyWrong: product_1 is valid — underscores are allowed in Java identifiers.
marks is valid — lowercase letters are allowed.
sales123 is valid — digits after the first character are allowed.

subject: Information Technology
text: Which of the following operators in Java is used to compare two values for equality? (2026 Board)
explanation: The == operator in Java is the equality comparison operator — it returns true if both operands have the same value. The single = is the assignment operator.
whyWrong: = is the assignment operator, not a comparison operator.
!= is the 'not equal to' operator, used to check inequality.
> is the 'greater than' operator, not equality.

subject: Information Technology
text: Which of the following is NOT a feature of a project? (2026 Board)
options: A project is complete when its end objectives are achieved.
A project has a beginning and an end.
explanation: By definition, a project operates with limited (finite) resources — budget, time, manpower. The requirement of infinite resources contradicts the fundamental nature of a project.
whyWrong: A project does end when objectives are achieved — this is a true feature.
A project has a defined start and end — a true feature.
A project must have specific, defined objectives — a true feature.

subject: Information Technology
text: Which of the following best describes webinars? (2026 Board)
options: Real-time lectures with opportunities to ask questions
explanation: Webinars (web seminars) are live, online sessions where a presenter delivers a lecture or presentation in real time, and participants can interact by asking questions through chat or audio.
whyWrong: Pre-recorded video courses are MOOCs or video tutorials, not webinars.
Text-based documents are static resources, not live sessions.
Interactive games are gamified learning platforms, not webinars.

subject: Information Technology
text: What is a major benefit of online learning? (2026 Board)
options: It only teaches how to use software.
It allows learners to study at their own location, time and pace.
It discriminates students on the basis of age, caste and qualification.
It is only available in regional languages.
explanation: The primary advantage of online learning is flexibility — learners can access content from anywhere, at any time, and progress at their own pace, making education more accessible.
whyWrong: Online learning covers a vast range of subjects, not just software use.
Online learning aims to be inclusive and accessible, not discriminatory.
Online learning is available in many languages globally, not only regional ones.

subject: Information Technology
text: Which attribute can be chosen as the primary key for the Student table with records (101-Rohan-Delhi-76.50, 102-Neha-Mumbai-74.00, 103-Aarav-Delhi-74.00, 104-Neha-Jaipur-75.75)? (2026 Board)
explanation: A primary key must be unique for every tuple and cannot be NULL. ID values (101, 102, 103, 104) are all unique. Name ('Neha' appears twice), City ('Delhi' appears twice), and Percentage (74.00 appears twice) all have duplicate values.
whyWrong: Name is not unique — 'Neha' appears for two different students.
City is not unique — 'Delhi' appears for two students.
Percentage is not unique — 74.00 appears for two students.

subject: Information Technology
text: Which of the following correctly matches the website with its main focus? (2026 Board)
options: w3schools.com – Humanities and Social Science courses
coursera.org – Drag and drop website development tool
ncert.nic.in – Online learning resources like e-books and journals
explanation: ncert.nic.in is the official NCERT website that provides free online access to NCERT textbooks (e-books), supplementary reading material, and educational resources for school students.
whyWrong: w3schools.com focuses on web development tutorials (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, SQL), not humanities.
coursera.org is an online course platform offering university-level courses, not a drag-and-drop website builder.
udacity.org offers tech-focused nanodegree programmes, not grammar testing.

subject: Information Technology
text: Which of the following is NOT an aggregate function in SQL? (2026 Board)
explanation: SQL aggregate functions operate on sets of values and return a single value: COUNT(), MAX(), MIN(), SUM(), AVG(). UPDATE is a DML command used to modify rows, not an aggregate function.
whyWrong: COUNT() is a standard SQL aggregate function that counts rows.
MAX() is a standard aggregate function that returns the maximum value.
SUM() is a standard aggregate function that returns the total.

subject: Information Technology
text: In Java, which of the following statements is correct about exception handling? (2026 Board)
options: A catch block can exist without a try block.
Multiple catch blocks can follow a try block to handle different types of exceptions.
The finally block is executed only if an exception occurs in the try block.
If no exception occurs in the try block, the corresponding catch block is executed.
explanation: In Java, a single try block can be followed by multiple catch blocks, each handling a different exception type. This allows fine-grained exception handling for different error scenarios.
whyWrong: A catch block must always be associated with a try block; it cannot exist independently.
The finally block executes regardless of whether an exception occurs or not.
The catch block executes ONLY when an exception occurs, not when the try block runs without error.

subject: Information Technology
text: Which of the following is an application of Database Management Systems (DBMS)? (2026 Board)
explanation: DBMS is designed to store, manage and retrieve structured data. Educational institutions use DBMS to maintain students' academic records, attendance, grades and personal information.
whyWrong: Creating digital paintings is done using graphics software, not a DBMS.
Playing audio/video files requires media players, not a DBMS.
Writing fictional stories uses word-processing software, not a DBMS.

subject: Information Technology
text: What is the purpose of WHERE clause in SQL? (2026 Board)
options: It adds a new column to a table.
It filters rows on the basis of condition.
It sorts the rows in ascending or descending order.
It renames columns of the table.
explanation: The WHERE clause in SQL is used to specify a condition that filters which rows (tuples) are included in the result of a SELECT, UPDATE or DELETE query.
whyWrong: Adding a new column uses ALTER TABLE ... ADD COLUMN.
Sorting rows uses ORDER BY clause.
Renaming columns uses AS (alias) in SELECT or ALTER TABLE.

subject: Information Technology
text: Which SQL command is used to modify the attribute values of one or more tuples in a table? (2026 Board)
explanation: The UPDATE command in SQL is used to modify existing attribute values in one or more tuples (rows) of a table, typically with a WHERE clause to target specific rows.
whyWrong: INSERT is used to add new tuples/rows, not modify existing ones.
DELETE removes entire tuples from a table, not just changes values.
SELECT is used to retrieve/query data, not to modify it.

subject: Information Technology
text: Which of the following statements is true about the switch statement in Java? (2026 Board)
options: The switch statement is used to execute a block of code based on the value of an expression.
The break statement is optional and has no effect on the execution of a switch.
If no case matches, the program generates an error.
A switch can have only one case statement.
explanation: The switch statement evaluates an expression and executes the code block of the matching case. This is its primary and correct purpose.
whyWrong: The break statement is optional in syntax, but omitting it causes fall-through to the next case — it does have a significant effect.
If no case matches and there is no default clause, the switch simply does nothing — no error is generated.
A switch can have multiple case statements, one for each value to test.

subject: Information Technology
text: Which of the following correctly describes online shopping? (2026 Board)
options: Customers can buy only books and electronics over the Internet.
Customers can browse items online, place them in a virtual basket and make payment.
Customers can shop online, but must pay only in cash at delivery.
Customers can select items online, but cannot have them delivered.
explanation: Online shopping involves browsing products on a website or app, adding desired items to a virtual shopping cart/basket, and completing the purchase through an online payment gateway.
whyWrong: Online shopping covers all categories of products, not just books and electronics.
Online shopping supports multiple payment methods including credit/debit cards, UPI, and net banking, not only cash on delivery.
Delivery is a core feature of online shopping — items can and typically are delivered to customers.

subject: Information Technology
text: Which of the following is known as the National Portal of India? (2026 Board)
explanation: www.india.gov.in is the official National Portal of India, serving as a single point of access to information and services offered by the central and state governments.
whyWrong: www.irctc.co.in is the portal for Indian Railway ticket booking, not the national government portal.
www.goidirectory.nic.in is a directory of government websites, not the main National Portal.
www.w3schools.com is a private web development tutorial site, not related to India's government.

subject: Information Technology
text: Which of the following statements is true about using the RESTRICT option while dropping a column in SQL? (2026 Board)
options: The column is dropped even if it is referenced in other tables.
The column cannot be dropped if it is being referenced in other tables.
The column is renamed instead of being dropped.
The column is dropped along with all dependent objects automatically.
explanation: The RESTRICT option prevents dropping a column (or table) if any other database objects (such as other tables with foreign key references, or views) still reference it, ensuring referential integrity is maintained.
whyWrong: Dropping even if referenced describes CASCADE behaviour, not RESTRICT.
RESTRICT does not rename; it prevents the drop if dependencies exist.
Dropping with all dependent objects describes CASCADE, which is the opposite of RESTRICT.

subject: Information Technology
text: In Java, which operator is used to access the data members and method members of an object? (2026 Board)
explanation: The dot (.) operator in Java is the member access operator. It is used to access instance variables (data members) and methods of an object, e.g., object.method() or object.field.
whyWrong: The = operator is the assignment operator, not a member access operator.
The + operator is for addition or string concatenation.
The comma operator is used to separate parameters or items, not to access object members.

subject: Information Technology
text: Which SQL clause is used to sort data in ascending or descending order? (2026 Board)
explanation: The ORDER BY clause in SQL sorts the result set in ascending (ASC) or descending (DESC) order based on one or more columns.
whyWrong: Sort By is not a standard SQL clause.
Group By is used to group rows with the same value in specified columns for aggregate functions, not for sorting.
Arrange By is not a valid SQL clause.

subject: Information Technology
text: In the Requirement Definition Phase of a Web Application Project, defining the scope involves: (2026 Board)
options: Listing features, goals, and project limitations
explanation: The Requirement Definition Phase focuses on understanding and documenting what the project will do. Defining scope means listing the features to be included, the goals to be achieved, and the boundaries/limitations of the project.
whyWrong: Designing the user interface belongs to the Design Phase.
Writing and testing code belongs to the Development and Testing Phase.
Deploying and managing the website belongs to the Deployment/Maintenance Phase.
